input_guards.source_nonassociativity: ONLY composition of 8x8 REAL LINEAR MAPS is associative. Octonion scalar multiplication is not reassociated.
input_guards.two_source_barGamma_claims: Direct-M coefficient and ordinary-metric Gamma transpose are both separately source asserted, not silently identified on the inconsistent source table.

operator_construction.G_c_matrix: G_c[b,a]=epsilon(b)*M[c,a]^b, output row b (conjugated-basis coordinates), input a
operator_construction.bar_D_matrix: D_c[b,a]=epsilon(c)*epsilon(a)*M[c,a]^b, output row b ordinary-basis coordinates, input a conjugated basis
operator_construction.upper_U_cd: U_cd = barGamma_c * Gamma_d (c<d, rightmost Gamma_d applied first)
operator_construction.lower_V_cd: V_cd = Gamma_c * barGamma_d (c<d, rightmost barGamma_d applied first)
operator_construction.bracket: [X,Y]=X*Y−Y*X using ordinary associative composition of endomorphism matrices, NOT octonion multiplication
operator_construction.span: span_Q of the exactly 28 source matrices indexed by all c<d in {0,...,7}
operator_construction.test_domain: All 28 choose 2 = 378 unordered distinct pairs of source generators; full 8×8 matrix commutators; both source barGamma constructions and both chiral blocks.

exact_method.scalars: Q rational arithmetic with BigInt numerator/denominator reduced by gcd after every operation. No finite fields, floating point tolerances or matrix name imports.
exact_method.source_basis_rank: Exact rational forward Gaussian row echelon over 64 matrix entries, retains all 28 source generator rows and their leading pivots.
exact_method.membership: Reduce the full flattened commutator against rational row echelon; zero residual means IN span_Q; nonzero rational residual means OUT of span_Q.
exact_method.sparse_witness: For first [U_01,U_06] or [V_01,V_06], linear functional is sum of two matrix entries; all 28 generators have value exactly zero but the commutator has value +2, independently certifying non-membership without full rank calculation.
exact_method.qualification_boundary: The exact rational proof concerns finite matrix operators constructed from the source-literal table. It does not prove/deny canonical octonion spin algebra or f4 theorem after a source correction.
